title: noccaea microphylla
intro: Noccaea microphylla, commonly known as Alpine Penny-cress, is a small, annual herb native to the mountainous regions of Europe. Alpine Penny-cress has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion, due to its anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Noccaea microphylla include glucosinolates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to have anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory effects.
